title: NatSec100 matched outcome and nonselection control pilot · acquisition 01

selection_contract.selected_universe: The published 2026 NatSec100 roster plus the explicitly discussed assessed nonselection or ineligibility examples in that edition.
selection_contract.matching_universe_required: Every source-addressable eligible but nonselected entity assessed under the same edition methodology.

sources.title: 2026 NatSec100
supports: The edition publishes a ranked roster of 100 companies.
The disclosed ranking inputs include U.S. government contracting activity, recent capital raised, total capital raised, and recent headcount growth.
Eligibility includes at least one U.S. government contract by December 31, 2025.
SpaceX and Anthropic are discussed as bounded assessed nonselection or ineligibility examples.
does_not_support: the complete rejected, withdrawn, ineligible, or FOCI-held universe
exact scoring weights, transformations, overrides, or source snapshots
ranking causation for later capital, awards, deployment, failure, acquisition, or exit

sources.title: 2025 NatSec100
supports: The prior edition describes a momentum-oriented ranking.
The report states that the rank is not a direct measure of operational impact.
does_not_support: direct longitudinal comparability to the 2026 methodology
a complete eligible but nonselected universe
causal attribution from ranking to outcomes

sources.title: 2024 NatSec100
supports: The edition describes weighted public-data inputs and cautions against treating them as perfect benchmarks of ultimate success.
Some list departures are associated with acquisition or public-market eligibility changes rather than generic failure.
does_not_support: direct comparability to the 2026 contract-screened universe
technical inferiority for entities leaving the list

open_denominators: edition-specific candidate, rejected, ineligible, withdrawn, and FOCI-held universe
exact scoring weights, transformations, source snapshots, overrides, and version history
legal-entity resolution for selected and matched-control companies
source-addressable pre-ranking and post-ranking capital, contract, award, nonaward, deployment, failure, acquisition, and exit rows
role-neutral matched nonselected controls with comparable sector, maturity, prior contracting, capital, and headcount
methodology correction, appeal, exception, and re-evaluation records
